meta.name: repo-fingerprint
meta.description: Discover repository structure, entrypoints, run/test/lint/build commands, CI setup, and sources of truth before making changes. Use at the start of unfamiliar repositories or before high-impact work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速了解陌生仓库的结构与关键配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的代码库，需要快速摸清项目结构。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand unfamiliar repository structure and key configs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar codebase and need to quickly grasp its structure.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先分析仓库结构、入口文件、运行/测试/构建命令、CI 配置等，然后生成一份仓库指纹 JSON 文件和快速运行指南。
howto.when: 当你开始接触一个不熟悉的仓库，或者要进行重要改动之前，Claude 会自动执行这个分析流程。

say.text: 帮我分析这个仓库的结构和运行方式。
say.note: Claude 会生成仓库指纹和运行指南。

say.text: 在修改代码前，先检查仓库的 CI 配置。
say.note: Claude 会读取 CI 文件并标记注意事项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze repository structure, entry points, run/test/lint/build commands, CI setup, etc., then produce a repo fingerprint JSON file and a quick run guide.
howto.when_en: When you start working on an unfamiliar repository or before making high-impact changes, Claude will automatically execute this analysis workflow.

say_en.text: Analyze this repository's structure and how to run it.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a fingerprint and run guide.

say_en.text: Before editing code, check the CI configuration first.
say_en.note: Claude will read CI files and flag any issues.
